oct07_caption_source_check.claim_checked: USDA recommends165F/about74C for poultry; check each piece at its appropriate thickest point, away from bone, and follow appliance/probe instructions.
oct07_caption_source_check.limits: Caption corrected to check each piece rather than imply a single thick piece proves all pieces safe; visual color alone is not a doneness test. Original USDA retrieval failed; official indexed text checked.
